chunks: So God will protect them from the evil of that day, and grant them happiness and joy,
ai.seo_question: How does God protect the faithful on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Nadrat al-Wajh* (radiance of the face), signifying the spiritual luminosity granted to the faithful as a direct result of their endurance during the *Yawm al-Sharr*. It underscores the divine transition from the anxiety of the Hereafter to the serenity of Paradise, reflecting the promise of reward for those who maintain steadfastness in faith.
